The *Modakadāyikātherīapadāna* is the thirteenth poem of the *Therīapadāna*, located within the late canonical strata of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Like other texts in the collection, it constitutes a verse hagiography recounting the past-life meritorious deed and ultimate spiritual liberation of an awakened Buddhist nun (*therī*). SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text across five languages [SuttaCentral].
